security_spec.violation_condition: In two-stage IOMMU translation, when VS-stage completes but G-stage leaf PTE lacks write permission causing an implicit guest page fault, QEMU reports the fault via riscv_iommu_report_fault() with iotval2 set to raw translated_addr without setting bit[0]=1 (implicit access indicator) or bit[1] appropriately for the implicit access type. If QEMU later implements implicit fault iotval2 formatting and copies the old reference model pattern of setting iotval2[1] from SADE/GADE (internal translation context config bits) instead of from the actual implicit access write flag, the guest OS can observe internal IOMMU configuration state through the fault queue record.
security_spec.summary: Old reference model leaked SADE (S-stage A/D Enable) to guest via iotval2[1] on implicit guest page fault; QEMU must use implicit access write flag for iotval2[1], not internal IOMMU DC_TC_SADE/GADE config bits
